issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

analyticWhitelist.description:
Config to limit the analytics considered for execution. List of analytic type names.
Empty list is considered as all analytics.

startOfTime.description:
Config to set the reference start time for period construction.
Value can be a date or a integer as number of days (+/-) from now.

endOfTime.description:
Config to set the reference end time for period construction.
Value can be a date or a integer as number of days (+/-) from now.

maxInvalDays.description: Config to limit max number of days for period construction.

analyticGroups.description: Config to define the grouped analytic mapping as json value.

enableMetricPriority.description: Config to enable dynamic priorities in analytics/metrics queue invalidation {@link MetricPriority}

evalHistoryInterval.description: The finest grain that will use DFE evaluation history for making decisions on when to evaluate DFEs..

maxHashLen.description: the maximum number of bytes allowed for a DFE metric data hash.

timeseriesTimeRangeSourceInfoTrackingEna.description: Source file information is tracked during analytic invalidation.
